en: The Dhāraṇī of Maitreya Bodhisattva Spoken by the Buddha,
translated by the Tripitaka Master of the Western Heaven, Imperial Censor of the Third Rank, Acting Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments,
Great Master of Enlightened Teaching, Subject Faxian, by Imperial Decree.

Tadyathā: siri siri, sarā sarā, suru suru, dara dara, tsara tsara, mahātsara, vara vara, mahāvara, kampa kampa, mahākampa, hūṃ masaradharma-akṣara-svāhā. The Dhāraṇī Spoken by the Buddha for Maitreya Bodhisattva.
